Theorem 1 (Chapter 136)

Subject: statistics | ID: 62794

Proposition

If X is a real manifold and T: X -> X is a stationary operator, then T admits a unique decomposition T = D + N where D is diagonalizable and N is nilpotent.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the idempotent operator \(T_{01360011}\) acting on the affine variety. By the idempotent decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{01360011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01360011\).

Step 2. By the metric spectral theorem, we decompose \(T_{01360012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the metric spectral family.

Step 3. By compactness of the Hermitian spectral family \(T_{01360013}\), the image is precompact in the Paley-Wiener space topology.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through Wavelet approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
